svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint on Azure, development: 22 nodes, 21 connections. 29 resources on Azure, framed by the module that declares them and nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from Terraform. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret.

svg.desc: Parcelpoint on Azure, development: 22 nodes, 21 connections. 29 resources on Azure, framed by the module that declares them and nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from Terraform. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret. Nodes: - Account: Azure subscription - Resource group: rg-parcel-dev (westeurope) - Observability: Monitoring (Module modules/monitoring) - log-parcel-dev (Log Analytics workspace PerGB2018), service - appi-parcel-dev (Application Insights web), service - Resource group: Compute (Module modules/compute) - id-parcel-dev-apps (Managed identity), identity - Service plan: asp-parcel-dev - app-parcel-dev-api (App Service), service - func-parcel-dev-events (Function app), function - Service plan (B1 Linux), service - Virtual network: Network (Module modules/network) - privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com (Private DNS zone), gateway - Subnet: snet-parcel-dev-endpoints - Subnet, service - Resource group: Data (Module modules/data) - pe-parcel-dev-labels (Private endpoint), gateway - Data tier: psql-parcel-dev - Postgres password, service - PostgreSQL flexible server (B_Standard_B1ms), database - tracking (Database), database - Storage: stparceldevlabels - Storage account (Standard), storage - labels (Blob container), storage - Messaging: sb-parcel-dev - nsg-parcel-dev-app to log-parcel-dev: diagnostics - privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com to Virtual network: DNS link - PostgreSQL flexible server to Subnet: subnet - PostgreSQL flexible server to privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com: DNS -
